definitions.explanation: The posterior part of the body that one sits on.
The back or trailing part of something.

examples.japanese: {椅子|いす}に{座|すわ}りすぎて{尻|しり}が{痛|いた}い。
examples.english: My bottom hurts from sitting in a chair too long.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんのお{尻|しり}を{拭|ふ}いてあげた。
examples.notes: お{尻|しり} is the polite form

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{尻|しり}が{軽|かる}くて、すぐに{転職|てんしょく}する。
examples.english: He's restless and changes jobs quickly.
examples.notes: {尻|しり}が{軽|かる}い = restless, fickle

examples.japanese: {列|れつ}の{尻|しり}に{並|なら}んだ。
examples.english: I lined up at the back of the queue.

examples.japanese: スカートの{尻|しり}のほうにシミがついている。
examples.english: There's a stain on the back part of the skirt.

examples.japanese: {靴|くつ}の{尻|しり}がすり{減|へ}って、{新|あたら}しいのを{買|か}わなければならない。
examples.english: The heels of my shoes are worn down, so I need to buy new ones.

notes:
Can be considered slightly crude in formal contexts. Alternative polite forms exist.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{尻|しり}が{重|おも}い - reluctant to get up/act, slow to start
・{尻|しり}が{軽|かる}い - restless, fickle, doesn't stay in one place
・{尻|しり}に{敷|し}かれる - to be henpecked (lit. to be sat on)
・{尻|しり}に{火|ひ}がつく - to have a fire under one's seat (to be in a desperate hurry)
・{尻尾|しっぽ}を{出|だ}す - to show one's true colors (lit. to show one's tail)

POLITE ALTERNATIVES:
・お{尻|しり} (polite form)
・{臀部|でんぶ} (medical/formal term)
